commit: fix(html): skip inlining icon and manifest links

truth.description: fileToBuiltUrl's default inline heuristic no longer keeps SVG files with a #fragment out of inlining, a rule only the HTML plugin now applies by passing shouldInline false, so the CSS url() replacer in css.ts, which reaches fileToBuiltUrl through fileToUrl without that option, inlines a small sprite such as fragment-bg.svg#icon-clock-view as a data URL and loses the fragment that the emitted file kept before.

distractions.why: Leaving shortcut out of the set is safe because a rel of shortcut icon is split on whitespace and still matches its icon token.
